warnings.text: Ordinary unnumbered base cards have no published odds. The blank odds cell is intentional, unanchored and must have no estimate. Historical 1900 is not used.

Ordinary autograph 199 is an unconfirmed owner-sheet SN value, not Topps-confirmed serial numbering. It is included by owner request at reduced relative weight 0.1; 12 other anchors have official Topps NumberedTo values.
Official SKU 5121 has one PACK ODDS population. BOX ODDS are reference only, not another format. No cards-per-pack or box configuration is inferred.

Checklist identities from the read-only reference JSON were cross-checked against all 179 official Topps IDs. Owner gid=0 matches all 13 official odds denominators; its unrelated 2025 Definitive heading is ignored. Total Packs 80000 is a comparison target, not an entered pack override.

project.referenceSource: Official 2023 Bowman Sapphire checklist and odds; owner published workbook 23 Bowman Sapphire MLB, gid=0. All estimates provisional and not yet calibrated.

rowIssues: BASE CARDS (unnumbered; odds not published): Invalid odds: . Use 1:3500, 6:1, or -.
calculation.assumptions: Default model: each format’s pack total is the WEIGHTED MEDIAN of its numbered anchors’ implied packs (implied packs = eligible subjects × serial × odds, less any fixed-format contribution), weighted by each anchor’s influence so base/insert anchors outweigh autograph/memorabilia. Each parallel’s estimate = packs ÷ odds ÷ eligible subjects. A dash means unavailable; anchors with an infeasible implied pool are excluded. These are estimates from published odds anchored on known serial numbers, not manufacturer-confirmed totals.
